course.title: Operations Research and Systems Analysis
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: Mc Burger fast fuod restaurant has only one Cashier. Customers arrive according to a Poisson distribution every 7 minutes and form one line to be served. The time to fill an order is exponentially distributed with a mean of 10 minutes. The waiting line does not accommodate more than 10 customers, including the one being served. Arriving customers go elsewhere if the line is full.
(i) Probability that the cashier is busy;
(ii) Probability that an arriving customer will not get service immediately but will find an empty space in the line;
(iii) Percentage of customers that will not get food from the restaurant;
(iv) Suppose that to three customers would like to get food together. What is the probability that their wish can be fulfilled?
